crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come…
“By your endurance you will win your lives.
My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the…
Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also…
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
“Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

translations.web: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
translations.bsb: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
translations.kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
translations.asv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
